title: Profile
description: Which repos use the profile, and where walkies are made.

name.description: The profile's name. Defaults to its folder name.

match.description: Git remote globs (host/owner/name, e.g. github.com/acme/*) that pick this profile.

allow.description: If set, the only remotes that may use this profile.

work_dir.description: Folder in the repo for walkie work. Must be gitignored.

template.description: Spec template, relative to the profile folder. A .spec.ts for browser recordings, a _test.dart for flutter ones; when it does not fit the runner, the engine's own template is used.

base_url.description: Where the app runs while recording.

runner.description: What records the app. browser: Playwright and Chromium (demo.spec.ts). flutter: an integration test on an iOS Simulator or Android emulator, with the screen recorded (demo_test.dart). auto: flutter when app_dir has a Flutter pubspec.yaml, else browser.

app_dir.description: flutter: the Flutter app's folder, relative to the repo root.

device.description: flutter: the simulator or emulator to record on (name, iOS UDID or Android serial). null: the one running, else the first iPhone simulator.

flutter.description: flutter: the command that runs Flutter in this repo, e.g. "puro flutter" or "fvm flutter".
